entry.title: Summer Palace · Silkworm Deity Temple
entry.note: The temple location agrees with the named visitor map point and the small courtyard roof group in overhead imagery. The facade, closed red doors, gray stone arch and rockery come from visitor photographs. The path joins a mapped garden route. Wall line, hall proportions and individual rocks are exterior reconstructions. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
